calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
exp AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM exp) AS targeted_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN exp USING(member_id)) AS in_both,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS holdout_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date > DATE '2025-11-24')) AS joined_after,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND NOT marketing_consent)) AS holdout_no_consent_on_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24')) AS holdout_no_version_on_start

calls.statement:
WITH t AS (SELECT campaign_id, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS targeted FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key GROUP BY 1),
h AS (SELECT campaign_id, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS held FROM campaign_holdout GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.mailing_list_size, h.held, t.targeted, h.held+t.targeted AS sum_groups, c.mailing_list_size-(h.held+t.targeted) AS diff, round(100.0*h.held/c.mailing_list_size,2) AS held_pct,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.valid_from<=c.start_date AND m.valid_to>=c.start_date AND m.marketing_consent) AS consent_at_start
FROM dim_campaign c JOIN h USING(campaign_id) JOIN t USING(campaign_id) WHERE c.campaign_id IN (5,14,15,16,13) ORDER BY 1;
SELECT campaign_id, target_group FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id=15

calls.statement:
WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND marketing_consent AND join_date<=DATE '2025-11-24'),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) AS elig_held,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM t)) AS elig_targeted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS targeted_not_elig,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS held_not_elig
